author: Bydle
quote: Unplayable piece of ****. A measly 30 fps in a fast-paced action game is a joke. The shootouts are artificially slowed down, the enemies act like morons, and you’re a bullet sponge—simply because it’s impossible to maintain any real sense of action-packed momentum with such a poor frame rate. It’s painful to look at. That’s not a figure of speech—my eyes actually hurt. Everything else falls short top - a massive sandbox, yet it’s wasted on brain-dead missions.

author: Bydle
quote:
I don't understand you whining people. The game is great, much better than the best assassin. Brilliant atmosphere. The graphics are elegant and run smoothly (ps5). The plotline is mindblowing. The attention to detail is sometimes even offensive - look at the NPSs glasses or shoes ... Humor is also fun in some places (the AI boss of a taxi corporation is a masterpiece).

WHAT ARE YOU PEOPLE ABOUT ??? I am already playing 17h and I did not encounter any significant error or drop in animation ...

If you treat the game as a GTA-style sandbox where you just drive & shoot carnage. Sorry. This is not what CP2077 is about. This is not a game for players like that.

Strong 10/10 for me. Whining of the GTA/fortnite community does not change anything here.

author: Bydle
quote: No reasonable scoreboard (in competitive mplayer game!!!). Poor map design. Guns with no kinetic power. Visuals good only from a distance. Poor customization and soldiers design. No war climate. No reason to play this scum. Applaing for a refund.

author: Bydle
quote: Gra mimo mocnych fundementow nie nadaje sie do niczego. To tylko techdemo. Nie istnieje system progresu postaci. To co jest to smietnik. Pomysl, ze najgorszy i najlepszy gracz dosteje tyle samo kredytow.... Szkoda komentowac. Dojenie frajerow. Pod zadnym pozorem nie dokladajcie do tego biznesu. Teraz skunksty z EA nagle kładą uszy po sobie po boją się o utrate licencji od Disneya i o premie roczne. To nic nie zmienia. Do dotykać tego ścierwa nawet patykiem.
